{{Quote|I haven't seen Neva since she authenticated the other head yesterday, Noble Curator.|Kaddreth|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Kaddreth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and worked as an assistant to [[Peema Ahuff]], the curator of the [[House Alde]] Royal Museum. In [[3643 BBY]] he informed Ahuff that his other assistant [[Neva (Alderaanian)|Neva]] had disappeared after performing genetic test on the head of [[Darth Bandon]].
